name: Toivo Group Oyj
summary: Toivo Group Oyj is a Finnish real estate enterprise with a comprehensive scope of operations covering property development, construction, ownership, management, and leasing. Its activities specifically include the development of land plots and the building of various residential units, such as apartments and single-family homes, which it then either owns or sells. Beyond these core real estate functions, the company also offers project management contracting services. Established in 2015, Toivo Group Oyj is headquartered in Espoo, Finland, and operates as a subsidiary of Raatihuone Oy.
